cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/emicro-deps')
from lark import Lark
grammar = r'''
start: policy*
policy: predicate action ";"
?predicate: "(" predicate "and" predicate ")" -> and_
          | "(" predicate "or" predicate ")" -> or_
          | "not" "(" predicate ")" -> not_
          | atom
?atom: "match" "(" ph ")" -> match
     | "startswith" "(" ph ")" -> startswith
     | "endswith" "(" ph ")" -> endswith
     | "contains" "(" ph ")" -> contains
ph: [IDENT ("," IDENT)*]
action: "allow" -> allow
      | "drop" -> drop
IDENT: /[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}/
%import common.WS
%ignore WS
'''
p=Lark(grammar,parser='lalr',maybe_placeholders=False)
for s in ['match(allow) allow;','match(and) allow;','match(match) allow;','match(not) allow;','match(drop) drop;','match(A) allow;','match(A)and(match(B)) allow;','match(A)and(B) allow;','not (match(A)) allow;','match(A)allow;']:
 try:print('OK',repr(s),p.parse(s).pretty())
 except Exception as e:print('FAIL',repr(s),type(e).__name__,str(e).splitlines()[0])
PY
